summary.text: Kim King is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 55 since 2011 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
King is a farmer who owns two small businesses and chairs the Tourism and Outdoor Recreation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kim King earned a B.S. in fitness and wellness management from Eastern Kentucky University in 2004.
Her professional experience includes owning two small businesses, Motive Force and 4 Kings Angus.

In the 2025-2026 session she chaired the Tourism and Outdoor Recreation Committee and also served on the House Agriculture, Economic Development & Workforce Investment, and Small Business & Information Technology committees.
